name: Uplyfted Pre-Roll | Canal St. Runtz
description:
Type of Strain 

Hybrid

Lineage 

Runtz x THC Bomb

Type of High 

This flower will make you feel like you are straight cruising down Euphoria Ave with the windows down and the music blasting!

Aroma 

Sweet, Berry, Diesel.

Taste 

Like the sweet, fruity milk left in the bowl after some fruity flakes.

Profile

ß-Caryophyllene, Limonene, Humulene

Helps With 

Stress – Anxiety – Relaxation
